title: Yarn | A Story Podcast
intro: Narrative documentaries and dramas. Whether we're spinning yarns or unraveling them, Yarn is a podcast about telling good stories.
about: We have 29 different stories now, each in a different style. Most episodes are standalone but some bigger stories are part of a series.

We've done a 3-part doc series on the history of disability, a 2-part docu-drama about a Nazi spy in Ireland during WW2. We've taken listeners on a trip around the Chernobyl exclusion zone, on a ride-along with a New York police officer and into the bizarre palace of a corrupt dictator.
Produced and presented by John Roche in Dublin, Ireland since 2017.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.blurb: Thirteen short stories: autobiographical audio dramas, myth, history and a murder in rural Ireland.

seasons.title: Season 2
seasons.blurb: Five documentaries, from an interview with a sober alcoholic to two days inside the Chernobyl exclusion zone.

seasons.title: Season 3
seasons.blurb: One story in two parts: the true, ridiculous mission of the Nazi spy who parachuted into neutral Ireland.

seasons.title: Season 4
seasons.blurb: A three-part miniseries on the history of disability, told in parallel with the history of everyone else.

seasons.title: Season 5
seasons.blurb: Five documentaries: a palace built on corruption, lone actor terrorism, the jury room, Kyiv under invasion and a stalker.

seasons.title: Season 6
seasons.blurb: Four documentaries, including the Signal Award winning Hotel on the Edge of Europe.

extrasBlurb: Side projects, a walking tour of Kilkenny, a radio show and podcast production services.
